offence_severity: Death (Section 302 IPC) with minimum/maximum punishment of life imprisonment
physical_harm: Deceased sustained one gun shot injury on the back, resulting in death; the mother of the deceased received injuries near her ear
number_of_offences: Two offences/counts charged; both were finally upheld
premeditation_planning: The court found that the appellants shared the common intention to commit the murder
key_evidence_accepted: The Supreme Court accepted the presence of appellant No.2 as established by consistent evidence of the eye-witnesses, and that he was armed with a rifle, sharing the common intention with appellant No.1. The post-mortem certificate and seized cartridges were also accepted as key evidence.
witness_credibility: The court assessed the main witnesses as credible, noting that the statement of PW-1 in Ex.-P1 was more reliable and corroborated by the statements of PWs 6 and 7. The court also found that the contradictions in the witnesses' statements did not affect the prosecution's case.

legal_representation.accused: Nagendra Rai, Sr. Adv., Rajesh, Advs.
legal_representation.state: Rahul Kaushik, Ms. Bhuvneshwari Pathak, Ms. Shilpi Satyapriya Satyam, Siddharth Chakravorty (for Mrs. Swarupama Chaturvedi)

investigation_status: FIR registered, charge sheet filed, trial completed

appeal_history.trial_court: Conviction and sentence of life imprisonment imposed
appeal_history.high_court: Affirmed the conviction and sentence of life imprisonment
appeal_history.supreme_court: Affirmed the conviction and sentence of life imprisonment

prosecution_argument: The prosecution argued that the appellants shared the common intention to commit the murder of the deceased, and that the presence of appellant No.2 was established by consistent evidence of the eye-witnesses, who also confirmed that he was armed with a rifle and thus shared the common intention acting in concert with appellant No.1.
defence_argument: The defence argued that there was no clear evidence of prior concert or meeting of mind before the commission of the offence, and that the deposition of the eye-witnesses were inconsistent and contradictory, which led to the trial court erred in basing the conviction upon such inconsistent evidence.
legal_principle_applied: The Supreme Court applied the legal principle that to invoke Section 34 IPC, it must be established that the criminal act was done by more than one person in furtherance of common intention of all, and that there was common intention on the part of several persons to commit a particular crime, and that the crime was actually committed by them in furtherance of that common intention.
sentencing_rationale: The final sentence of life imprisonment was imposed because the High Court affirmed the conviction under Section 302 IPC read with Section 34 IPC, and the Supreme Court found no reason to interfere with the impugned judgment.
other_sentence_order: The appellant No.2 shall surrender within a period of six weeks from today to serve the remaining period of sentence, failing which he shall be taken into custody.
